sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Rangers, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will repel enemy attacks with his longbow.

His energetic disposition conceals his age.

sections.title: Token
sections.text: Two pieces of flint strung together. It was from these small things that civilization was born.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: Rangers serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. A longtime veteran, he has traveled to many different places prior to serving in Rhodes Island's reserves. An expert archer, he still retains the characteristic agility and vigor of the Savras despite his advanced age.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Radiological scan showed clear outlines of internal organs, with no visiable abnormalities. Originium Particle Test of the circulatory system indicates no Oripathy. The subject is confirmed uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Rangers shows no signs of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Rangers seldom visits regions affected by Oripathy.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: A master of camouflage and utilizing the environment to his advantage, Rangers favors pre-emptive strikes using the element of surprise over waiting for his prey.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text: Rangers is, without doubt, an excellent storyteller whose head is filled with fantastic tales and a desire to share them with others. After each morning class, many younger Operators offer 'Grandpa Rangers' a glass of water and beg him to regale them.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text: Unlike that of most Savras, Rangers's skin provides no natural camouflage at all. But he is also more confident and more open to communication than most of his kin. Whether that is a blessing or a curse is strictly up to him to decide.
